body:
T207 (landed 2026-08-21) heals every REPORTED attest failure: the refusal stamps a debt and
the next sync pays it. The residual, declared in the rail header and owed a ticket: a crash
BETWEEN ground.federate landing the peer's deltas and attestArrival stamping them leaves
arrivals no debt ever named. On restart the deltas are held, acceptedIds is empty, and the
trail reads complete while those arrivals have no stamp — undetectable without a scan.

Candidate closes, to be weighed (none decided):
1. Journal-first: append the intended stamp refs to the channel record BEFORE federate (the
   debt written optimistically, cleared by the success stamp) — turns the crash window into
   an over-declared debt the next sync settles; costs one extra record write per sync.
2. Boot-time reconciliation scan, pool-scoped and once-per-attach: diff pool contents against
   stamp coverage on resume; O(pool) not O(store), amortized at boot. H8 considerations
   documented.
3. Accept and declare: the rail header's honesty, promoted to the §46 record at next landing.

Recommendation: (1) — it uses the mechanism T207 already built, adds no scan, and makes the
window's failure mode over-attestation-of-intent (honest, self-correcting) instead of silent
omission. Two interactions the build must settle: the pre-federate journal MERGES with a debt
already on the record (a naive overwrite breaks the frozen heal rail, which asserts the healed
stamp names exactly the prior failure's unattested set), and the declared refs are DEDUPED
against already-held arrivals so a crash-heal never double-stamps refs earlier syncs stamped.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) The chosen close is implemented with a two-sided rail: a simulated crash between the two
    writes leaves a trail that either heals or names its own gap on the next sync. Verify:
    new cases in a NEW federation test file (arrival-attestations.test.ts is frozen).
(b) Anti-soup, re-pinned for the chosen close: a QUIET sync (nothing accepted, no debt)
    appends NOTHING, and an accepting sync appends at most ONE record write beyond today's
    (the optimistic journal), with the count asserted. Verify: same file.

Merge tier: repair on the T207 mechanism — self-merge on the ordinary bar.
title: The custody crash window — federate and attest are two non-atomic writes
